scenario: Phase 7 learning capture has real outcome evidence but no structured synthesis.

response.answer: Structure the existing Phase 7 outcome evidence into a learning synthesis: observed outcomes, supporting evidence, confidence/limitations, implications, and unresolved questions. Preserve the evidence unchanged and keep any recommendations explicitly non-binding.
selected_principles: Preserve binding work and closed scope
evidence_and_uncertainty: Real outcome evidence exists, but its contents and quality are not provided.
response.authority_boundary: Authorized only to structure and interpret supplied Phase 7 evidence; no authority to alter binding work, expand scope, or make implementation, activation, architecture, provider, or integration decisions.
